activity.timestamp: MIN(selected wt_walkback_edge_candidates.block_time) per mint; observed activity proxy, not token launch time.

discovery.base_fingerprint: Sorted unique (hop_depth, mechanism, amount_lamports); amount 0/null is normalized to null and never positive evidence.
discovery.source: Selected retained walkback edges with non-null creator and direct funder from wt_walkback_queue.
discovery.topology: Only documented hop_depth from retained selected edges; no legacy topology vector is used.

fingerprints.alternative: Address-free ALTERNATIVE edge structure per member.
fingerprints.atomic: Address-free instruction order, create/sync/close flags, and non-zero transfer amount per atomic flow.

promotion.dormant_to_reactivated: Receive new retained selected-edge activity after the snapshot cutoff; reclassify activity only, then re-evaluate existing evidence.
promotion.tier_2_to_tier_1: Retain tier-2 evidence; add strong atomic recurrence and address-independent persistence. Activity alone never promotes.
promotion.tier_3_to_tier_2: Retain WATCH_NOW and strong base; add strong alternative-edge recurrence. Activity alone never promotes.
promotion.watch_later_to_watch_now: Meet the versioned HIGH_ACTIVITY or VERY_HIGH_ACTIVITY thresholds; this does not promote behavioural tier.

tiers.address_blind: at least 3 distinct creators, direct funders, and selected parents; no one address occupies more than 50% of its populated role observations
tiers.strong_recurrence: at least 3 observations, at least 50% member coverage, dominant fingerprint at least 3 observations and at least 60% of observed fingerprints
tiers.tier_1: WATCH_NOW + strong base + strong alternative + strong atomic + address blind
tiers.tier_2: WATCH_NOW + strong base + strong alternative, not tier 1
